specialRules.ruleFull: The warband may capture human Swabbies with the Swabbies rules. One who agrees joins the Deck Hands; one who refuses becomes a Floordog.
The warband may not start a campaign game with a Swivel Gun on its roster. In a one-off game it may buy one for 2D6 gc on top of its price.
The warband counts as a Human Pirate warband, as Ostlanders and Averlanders count as Mercenaries.

In any campaign set in the Old World, Mordheim, Albion, Sylvania and Sartosa among them, roll two dice for the order of deployment and take the lower. A Compass cancels this and gives nothing more. The warband does not suffer it in the Border Town Burning campaign, nor in Lustria, Khemri or the Crusades.
If the Disgraced Warlord is killed, one of the Shanghai'ers takes over, as a Champion does in a Mercenary warband.
Any pirate within 6" of the Disgraced Warlord may use his Leadership for any Leadership test.

fighters.name: Dragon Monk
fighters.equipment: A Dragon Monk takes no penalty at all for fighting unarmed and gains +1 Attack when he does. He may never wear armour.

specialRules.ruleFull: Fighting unarmed in hand-to-hand combat, a Dragon Monk causes a critical hit on a roll to wound of 5 or 6 instead of 6. While he wields a quarterstaff, only his unarmed attacks cause a critical hit on a 5+.
A Dragon Monk may never use a poison or a venom of any kind.

A Gunner carrying the warband's Swivel Gun always counts as an individual and may never have anyone else with him. As the warband may hold only one Swivel Gun, the Gunner who carries it must either be a new Gunner or be split from an existing group, in which case he keeps the experience and skills he had.

A Martial Artist always counts as carrying a Rope & Hook. He may also re-roll a failed Initiative test for leaping a gap, jumping down, a diving charge, and the test a rope allows for climbing up or down.
Floordogs are not hired: they come to the warband by the Swabbies rules.

Floordogs need not be armed alike. Each may be given different equipment, but only from the Floordog Equipment list. A Floordog may never use magic or cast a spell of any kind, whatever his background.
If the warband routs, every Floordog who had already left the table in an earlier turn is taken to have escaped: remove him from the roster as if he had been killed.

specialRules.rulename: Don't mind them Lao Xiong, they ain't true pirates
specialRules.ruleFull: A Floordog who is running away or has been taken out of action does not count towards the warband's rout test.

specialSkillsList.name: Angel of the Sword
specialSkillsList.description: Wielding a Katana, the model chooses each round of combat either an extra attack or a re-roll of his parry. He declares it at the start of the combat phase, before warriors roll for Initiative.

specialSkillsList.name: Knowledge of Shadows
specialSkillsList.description: Whenever the warrior charges a warrior who could not see him from the start of this turn, because he was hidden or charged on an Initiative test, he gains +1 to hit and +1 on injury rolls.

specialSkillsList.name: Art of the Silent Death
specialSkillsList.description: The warrior may use his bare hands as weapons with no penalty. Doing so he causes a critical hit on a natural 5 or 6, and gains an attack as if wielding two weapons. At the start of any round he may choose to wield a weapon in any of his hands, but then loses the critical hit on a 5.

specialSkillsList.name: Energy Focus
specialSkillsList.description: Dragon Monks only. Fighting unarmed, the Hero may give up any number of his Attacks, each for +1 Strength in close combat.

specialSkillsList.name: Monk Weaponry
specialSkillsList.description: The Hero may use any hand-to-hand or missile weapon from the Monk Equipment list, and may learn Energy Focus.

rules.text: A warrior wearing Cathayan Plate Armour has a basic saving throw of 4+.
A warrior wearing Cathayan Plate Armour and a shield suffers -1 Movement.

flags.what: The skill table's ticks are images, so page 2 was opened as an image. Disgraced Warlord: all seven columns. Shanghai'er: Combat, Shooting, Speed, Pirate, Special. Dragon Monk: Combat, Academic, Strength, Speed, Pirate, Special. Litter Bearer: Combat, Speed, Pirate, Special.

The Pirate column is the Pirate Skills list of the Sartosa campaign rules (Sartosa Skills, Hired Swords and Dramatis Personae, p1-2), not this PDF: it is the shared Sartosa Pirate Skills group, declared in sartosan-pirates.json and named by each hero who ticks it.

A stray "Toughened Leathers . . . 5 gc" line sits above the Gunner Equipment List heading, in the right column and under no heading. Both the Pirate list and the Gunner list already sell Toughened Leathers at 5 gc, so it is left out.

The Katana (20 gc, Rare 10; close combat, As user +1, Two-handed and Parry) is our Dragon Sword, which carries "In some older material, the Dragon Sword was referred to as Katana" and holds the same price, rarity and rules: the lines link it and show it as Katana, and the warband gets a price row of its own at Rare 10. Cathayan Plate Armour (120 gc, Rare 11; a 4+ save and -1 Movement with a shield) is a stub.

The Quarterstaff, Chain sticks, Cathayan Candles, Fish-Hook Shot and Swivel Gun with its three ammunitions are ours already, shown under this list's names. The Monk list sells Throwing Stars at 10 gc, where the Pirate list sells Throwing Stars/Knives at 15 gc: both are our Throwing Knives/Stars, each at its own line's price.
The Cathayan Candles line is "25+D6 gc". A list line carries only a whole number, so it is 25 gc; our item is 25 + D6 gc, Rare 9, which is unchanged and is what the store charges.
The Pirate list's Heavy Armour is 50 gc, as ours is; the Sartosa Equipment PDF's trading list prints Heavy Armour at 50 gc Rare 7, where ours is Common (open decision 20).
Floordogs are taken by Special Recruitment and no hire price is printed, so their cost is 0 gc.
The Dragon Monk replaces a Shanghai'er, so the warband holds at most 5 heroes; our templates hold no replacement rule, so the four counts stand as printed (1 + 2 + 1 + 2).
A Cathay Pirate warband needs at least 3 models: our templates hold no minimum, so it is not imported. No henchmen group sizes and no maximum profile are printed: the crew takes our Human race.

The Martial Artist's Agile (he counts as carrying a Rope & Hook and re-rolls failed Initiative tests for climbing and leaping) is not the Grace of Shornaal mutation Agile (+1 to Initiative tests), so it is kept apart as "Agile (Martial Artist)". The Dragon Monk's rule Art of Silent Death and the special skill Art of the Silent Death are worded differently and do different things (the rule is about a quarterstaff, the skill about an extra attack), so both are kept.
The Litter Bearer is listed under the Heroes, with a row in the skill table, and starts with 0 experience: as printed.

Sartosa Errata p14: "the Pirate Equipment List for all nationalities (including Cathayan) now has Handgun added on to it, making it available to all members of each warband" - a Handgun line at the setting's own 35 gc.
